run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:56:25Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert is a symptom of failing checkout traffic, which traces to loss of connectivity between shipping and quote. Frontend error spans in the hour to 02:12:14 are confined to the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, its API-route span, the grpc PlaceOrder client span and the POST server span, ~284 error spans each per hour, plus 91590 unset-status spans); GET/other operations show zero errors. The error burst starts in the minute ending 01:56:00 (matching the alert start 01:56:25), holds ~200-280 error spans/min through the minute ending 02:04:00, and was absent before 01:56. The same checkout-path errors appear on checkout (HTTP POST and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 242/h) and on shipping (/get-quote and POST quote, 241/h), with frontend-proxy ingress/egress error spans rising from a 9.3/h background to ~259-271/h. Kubernetes events show a Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning a NetworkChaos object every minute from 01:54:27 to the last visible event at 02:04:27; each experiment reports 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9' and for both quote pods (quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt), then 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Recovered' about 55 s later. Shipping logs show repeated 'Requesting quote' with no 'Sending Quote' during those intervals and bursts of completions at each recovery, while quote logs show request arrivals stopping during the same intervals and resuming immediately after recovery with no errors and normal 'Calculated quote' processing. All otel-demo pods are Running/ready with restartCount 0 and start times 01:20 (no rollout or crash), and quote/shipping/checkout endpoints are populated. Conclusion is partial because the fault is evidenced mainly by Kubernetes events and because the Schedule/NetworkChaos spec (selector, direction, action, duration) could not be read in this Run, so the exact injected fault type is inferred from object naming and observed behaviour rather than read directly.

claims.text: In the hour ending 2026-11-18T02:12:14Z, frontend produced 1134.6 error-status spans and 91590.25 spans with no status (STATUS_CODE_UNSET); the error spans are not a request count.

Frontend error spans in that hour are confined to the checkout path: span names POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder each show ~283.65 error spans, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and tcp.connect show 0.

The frontend error burst begins in the minute ending 01:56:00 (216 error spans in that 1-minute window, samples at 01:51:00-01:55:00 are 0) and stays at 200-280 error spans per minute through the minute ending 02:04:00.

In the one-hour baseline window 00:50:00-01:50:00, no frontend, checkout or shipping error spans are returned; only ad, fraud-detection and recommendation flagd EventStream spans (1.0-2.1) and frontend-proxy 'ingress' (9.3) have error spans, i.e. a small background level.

Over the 59 minutes to 02:04:00, error-status spans are observed on checkout (span HTTP POST 242.05 and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 242.05), shipping (/get-quote 240.98 and POST quote 240.98), frontend (POST 257.68, POST /api/checkout 257.68, executing api route /api/checkout 257.68, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 257.68) and frontend-proxy (ingress 270.88, router frontend egress 258.66), while ad/fraud-detection/recommendation EventStream spans stay at the 2-4 background level.

Kubernetes events in namespace chaos-mesh show a Schedule object named otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition creating a new NetworkChaos object every minute from 01:54:27 through the last visible spawn at 02:04:27 (messages 'Create new object: otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-<suffix>').

Each spawned NetworkChaos object (e.g. ...-nh2wt at 01:54:27, ...-wg96t at 01:55:27, ...-w588w at 01:56:27) logs 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9', 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt', then 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' for the same three pods roughly 55 seconds later.

shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 logs between 01:54:00 and 01:56:40 show long runs of 'Requesting quote' with no 'Sending Quote' (e.g. 01:55:02 through 01:55:21) followed by bursts of 'Sending Quote'/'Tracking ID Created' at 01:55:22-01:55:26 and again at 01:56:22-01:56:26, i.e. quote calls stall for the length of each chaos window and drain on recovery.

quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b logs show request-driven 'Calculated quote' lines stopping during each partition window and resuming right after each recovery (01:55:22, 01:56:22, 01:57:22, 01:58:22, 01:59:22, 02:00:22, 02:01:22, 02:02:22, 02:03:22, 02:04:24) with no error lines, so quote kept serving whenever traffic reached it.

The otel-demo application pods, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-d2vwq, checkout-5dccddf8bb-vz2zd, shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and both quote pods, are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and start times 2026-11-18T01:20:1xZ.

Endpoints for the quote service (two addresses 100.96.2.155, 100.96.4.53), shipping (100.96.4.227) and checkout (100.96.4.36) on port 8080 exist in namespace otel-demo, so service-to-pod routing is populated.

A pod restart or rollout is not the mechanism: all otel-demo pods show restartCount 0 and start times at 01:20, before the first error minute (ending 01:56:00), and no frontend/checkout/shipping pod has a previous container instance available.

quote itself shows no failure: its spans are non-error only (POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} each 862.5 calls per 59m, no error-status series), and its logs contain only 'Calculated quote' with no errors, so the loss is in reaching quote rather than in quote's own processing.

Rejected: frontend's own GET/other routes or cart/product/ad/recommendation dependencies are failing. In the incident hour all non-checkout frontend span names show 0 error spans, and cart, product-catalog, currency, payment, email and ad show no error spans (ad/fraud/recommendation only their ~2-4 per hour flagd EventStream background, also present in the baseline hour).

The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition is the source of the fault: each NetworkChaos it spawns separates the shipping pod from both quote pods for ~55 s per minute, so shipping's quote calls block, checkout PlaceOrder fails, and frontend's POST /api/checkout returns errors; the Schedule name states a network partition, but the action/direction/selector fields were not readable in this Run.

Read the Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition and one of its NetworkChaos objects (namespace chaos-mesh) to confirm action, direction, target selector and duration, and decide whether this scheduled partition should be paused or its scope narrowed; it is the object creating the recurring fault.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition and its NetworkChaos/PodNetworkChaos specs could not be read: those kinds are not in the Kubernetes kind list available in this Run, so the injected action, direction, pod selector, duration and schedule interval are inferred from object names, event messages and observed behaviour, not read directly.

No NetworkChaos event was returned after 02:04:27 (event source_end_at 02:04:27), so whether the Schedule kept spawning experiments afterwards and when the fault ended are unknown; a 5-minute-window sample ending 02:09:14 returned 0 frontend errors, while 1-minute queries had data only through 02:04:00, so the end of the error burst is not established.

Jaeger returned no traces for shipping in 01:50:00-02:12:14 and none for frontend operation 'POST /api/checkout' with error=true in 01:54:00-02:06:00, so span-level error messages and parent-child edges for the failing requests could not be inspected.

The frontend container produced no readable stdout lines in 01:54:00-02:06:00, and shipping/checkout logs contain no explicit error text; the exact gRPC status code (e.g. DeadlineExceeded vs Unavailable) seen by checkout and shipping was not observed.
The query for NetworkPolicies in namespace otel-demo returned no items; an empty result does not prove no policy exists, so a policy-based cause is unchecked rather than excluded.

list_prometheus_rules returned no data for rule name RequestErrorRate, so the alert's exact expression and threshold were not verified; only the alert annotation's reported error rate (1.111 req/s) is available.
Trace-derived span metrics lag the query end by about 9 minutes (freshness ~520-553 s, data_as_of 02:04:00), so metric coverage after 02:04:00 is unverified.
next_steps: Inspect the Chaos Chaos Mesh objects (Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition, namespace chaos-mesh) with a tool that can read chaos-mesh CRDs to confirm action=partition, direction, selector and duration, and to see whether the schedule is still active.
Capture checkout/shipping gRPC error codes for PlaceOrder and the quote call during an active NetworkChaos window to record the exact failure status.
If the partition is unintended, pausing the Schedule after operator approval and re-checking frontend POST /api/checkout error spans would confirm the causal link.
